{{nihongo|'''Ikagashi Shrine'''|伊加加志神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Ikagashi Shrine''' (いかがしじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Tokushima|af|Tokushima-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Tokushima|ar|توكوشيما (محافظة)|az|Tokuşima prefekturası|azb|توکوشیما اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Tokushima|be|Такусіма (прэфектура)|bg|Токушима (префектура)|bn|তোকুশিমা প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Tokushima|cdo|Tokushima-gâing|ce|Токусима (префектура)|ceb|Tokushima-ken|ckb|پارێزگای تۆکوشیما|cs|Prefektura Tokušima|cy|Tokushima (talaith)|da|Tokushima-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Tokushima|eo|Gubernio Tokuŝimo|es|Prefectura de Tokushima|et|Tokushima prefektuur|eu|Tokushima (prefektura)|fa|استان توکوشیما|fi|Tokushiman prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Tokushima|frr|Tokushima-ken|ga|Maoracht Tokushima|gl|Prefectura de Tokushima|hak|Tokushima-yen|he|טוקושימה (מחוז)|hr|Tokushima (prefektura)|hu|Tokusima prefektúra|hy|Տոկուսիմա (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Tokushima|ilo|Prepektura ti Tokushima|it|Prefettura di Tokushima|ja|徳島県|jv|Préfèktur Tokushima|ka|ტოკუსიმის პრეფექტურა|ko|도쿠시마현|lt|Tokušimos prefektūra|lv|Tokusimas prefektūra|mk|Токушима (префектура)|mni|ꯇꯣꯀꯨꯁꯤꯃꯥ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|तोकुशिमा प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Tokushima|ne|तोकुसिमा|nl|Tokushima (prefectuur)|no|Tokushima (prefektur)|os|Токусимæ (префектурæ)|pl|Prefektura Tokushima|pnb|ضلع ٹوکوشیما|pt|Tokushima|ro|Prefectura Tokushima|ru|Токусима (префектура)|sd|ٽوڪوشيما پريفيڪچر|se|Tokushima prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Tokushima|simple|Tokushima Prefecture|sk|Tokušima (prefektúra)|sq|Prefektura Tokushima|sr|Префектура Токушима|su|Tokushima Prefecture|sv|Tokushima prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Tokushima|tg|Префектураи Токушима|th|จังหวัดโทกูชิมะ|tl|Prepektura ng Tokushima|tr|Tokushima (prefektörlük)|tt|Токусима (префектура)|uk|Префектура Токусіма|ur|توکوشیما پریفیکچر|vi|Tokushima|war|Tokushima (prefektura)|wuu|德岛县|zh|德岛县|zh_classical|德島縣|zh_min_nan|Tokusima-koān|zh_yue|德島縣|qid=Q160734}}, {{ill|Yoshinogawa, Tokushima|Q592500|qid=Q592500}}, {{ill|Kawashima-chō Kuwamura|Q28689393|qid=Q28689393}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

=== History ===
The date of its foundation is unknown. Until the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} it was called “Hinomi (Hinomikoto) Daimyōjin.” In the 3rd year of Meiji ({{ill|1870|Q7741|qid=Q7741}}) it was renamed to its present name, and in May of the following year it was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. The former shrine site was lost due to flooding of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yoshino River}}, but it was later relocated to its current location.

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
